code:
$ docker system df
TYPE          TOTAL   ACTIVE   SIZE      RECLAIMABLE
Images        14      3        4.8GB     3.9GB (81%)
Containers    6       2        340MB     280MB (82%)
caption: The RECLAIMABLE column is the number that matters -- most usage often sits in things nobody needs.

code:
$ docker images -f dangling=true
REPOSITORY   TAG      IMAGE ID       SIZE
<none>       <none>   9f3a1b2c4d5e   412MB
caption: The previous version of an image after a rebuild reuses the same tag -- the old layers survive, untagged.

eyebrow: Targeted cleanup, one category at a time
code:
$ docker container prune
$ docker image prune        # dangling only
$ docker volume prune
$ docker network prune
caption: Each one asks for confirmation and only touches its own category -- the safe, routine cleanup.

code:
$ docker system prune -a --volumes
WARNING! This will remove:
  - all stopped containers
  - all images without at least one container
Are you sure you want to continue? [y/N]
caption: Read the warning before typing y -- on a shared machine, it removes more than you might expect.
